subtasks.description: Declare all internal storage: individual registers for each configuration register per S005 (argument, cmd_setting, etc.), BD FSM state register, registered outputs, and intermediate wires. Include reset values from S007 for all registers.

Generate combinational decode logic for address decoding (S005 register addresses), read data mux selecting from internal regfile or input status registers, write strobes for each writable register, BD FSM next-state and control signals (we_m_xx_bd, int_ack, wb_ack_o) per S008, and flag signals (cmd_int_busy, int_busy, new_cmd, we_ack) per S006. Ensure all next-state signals are solely combinational.
constraints: If handling BD writes with RAM_MEM_WIDTH=16, unroll the logic for two sequential writes explicitly; avoid generate constructs.
All next-state logic must be purely combinational.

subtasks.description: Implement clocked processes (always @(posedge wb_clk_i or posedge wb_rst_i)) that update all registers: on reset, apply values per S007 (int_ack=1, others 0, configuration registers to S005 defaults); on posedge, write configuration registers when strobed, advance BD FSM state, update output registers with combinational next-state signals, and handle BD multi-cycle write (S008).
constraints: Use scalar registers; avoid unpacked arrays in FSM state.
Reset is asynchronous active high; all updates explicitly clocked.

subtasks.description: Directly assign internal register values to output ports as defined in interface S003. No extra logic; purely wire connections.
